facts.text: CON IL CONTRIBUTO DELLA FONDAZIONE VITO CORLEONE
facts.why: Mary chairs the Vito Corleone Foundation in the film, and Michael gives it millions for charity.
Altobello is poisoned by a birthday cannoli and watches the opera from the box. No prosciutto and melon is in the transcript or plot.
facts.fix: a starter before Don Altobello's birthday cannoli

facts.text: hand-rolled in the kitchen while the family looks the other way
facts.why: Mary and Vincent cook together in the kitchen (the famous gnocchi scene), but they are alone and nobody looks the other way.
facts.fix: hand-rolled in the kitchen, far too close for cousins

vibe.verdict: A properly grand opera night in Palermo, with the cannoli and orange juice winks that a fan will love.
missing: Mary shot on the opera house steps (Teatro Massimo)
